title: AI Training and Evaluation Demo
summary: An interactive AI evaluation practice dashboard focused on issue classification, severity assessment, source grounding, feedback writing, and evaluator calibration.

content.business_need: Demonstrate how AI-generated content can be evaluated systematically for accuracy, clarity, grounding, severity, and usefulness.
content.audience: Reviewers, evaluators, and hiring teams assessing AI training and evaluation capabilities.
learning_objectives: Identify and classify issues in AI-generated content.
Assess issue severity and likely user impact.
Check whether claims are supported by provided source material.
Compare judgments against an expert calibration model.
content.role: Evaluation framework design, scenario design, rubric development, interaction design, copywriting, and front-end development.
content.design_approach: Use fictional and sanitized scenarios, explicit evaluation criteria, severity distinctions, and expert comparisons to make evaluator reasoning visible and repeatable.
content.development_process: Built as a custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript demo to showcase AI training and evaluation workflows without exposing client or employer information.
outcomes: Demonstrates AI output evaluation and model assessment skills.
Demonstrates actionable feedback writing and calibration logic.
Provides a reusable interaction pattern for future evaluator-training examples.

source_material_notes: Public demo uses fictional and sanitized evaluation scenarios.
